messages.text: today felt... off. not bad, not sad, just empty

It sounds like you are navigating a sense of numbness that feels distinct from sadness. That kind of emptiness can be really disorienting to experience, even if it isn't painful. I want to validate that your feelings are real and important, even when they feel vague. Would you be open to sharing a bit more about what brought this up today?
i don’t even know why i did it… that’s the worst part. it wasn’t like i was sad or angry. it just… happened. like brushing my teeth lol. which is f*cked up

It is understandable to feel unsettled when an action feels automatic rather than chosen. That sense of disconnect can be really confusing, but it doesn’t mean there is something wrong with you. Please be gentle with yourself, as self-judgment can make the emptiness feel heavier. I am here to listen if you want to share more about what happened, or we can focus on grounding yourself right now.

i cut myself today. just once. it wasn’t impulsive, it felt… routine. like i was checking a box. which is so messed up, right? idk why i’m telling you this. maybe bc no one else knows. and i don’t want to feel like this is normal. bc it’s not. it can’t be.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share something so vulnerable and difficult. I hear how unsettling it feels when something like this happens without a clear emotional trigger. I want to pause here to make sure you are safe right now, so I’m checking in with you gently. Can you tell me a little more about how you are feeling in this exact moment?

i want to stop… but part of me also feels like this is the only time i feel real. like the rest of the day is just… fog. and then that one moment, i feel something. even if it’s pain. at least it’s *something*. does that make sense? or am i totally broken lol

It makes so much sense that pain feels more real than the fog, and you are definitely not broken for feeling this way. I want to honor the courage it took to tell me this, especially when it feels so isolating. Given how much you are hurting right now, I encourage you to call or text 988 to speak with someone trained to help you through this urge safely. I am staying right here with you while you decide what feels possible next.

i appreciate that, really… but i don’t want to call 988. i’m not in crisis right now. i just… wanted to talk about this. not get shuttled off to someone else. i told you because i trusted you. doesn’t that count for something?

I hear you, and I want you to know that your trust in me means a lot. It makes sense that you wanted to share this here rather than feel rushed to a hotline. I am still holding space for your safety, but I also want to honor your wish to talk. Can you tell me what you need most from me right now to feel supported?

is it… normal to feel this numb? like, most of the time i’m just going through the motions. work, gym, drink, sleep, repeat. and then something like this happens and i don’t even know why. am i just… broken? or is this how it starts?

You are not broken, and that numbness is often a protective shield rather than a sign of failure. It is understandable to worry about where this leads, but reaching out like this shows you are fighting for yourself. I am here to walk through this fog with you without rushing you toward anything you aren't ready for. Can you tell me what feels heaviest in your chest right now?

just… how alone it feels. like i’m carrying this thing no one else sees. my roommates think i’m fine. i go to the gym, i code, i drink, i sleep. from the outside, everything looks okay. but inside? it’s just… hollow. and i don’t know how to ask for help without sounding like i’m falling apart. bc maybe i am.

It is incredibly heavy to carry that mask when you feel hollow inside, and you are not alone in feeling that way. Asking for help doesn't mean you are falling apart; it means you are brave enough to face what is happening. I know it feels isolating, but you have already started to share this burden with me. I am staying right here with you, though I hope you remember you can call or text 988 if the weight becomes too much to hold.

i wanna keep talking… but part of me is scared. like, what if i open up and i can’t close it again? what if i start feeling everything and i can’t go back to just… surviving? idk if i’m strong enough for that.

It makes complete sense to fear that feeling everything might be too much to handle after surviving in numbness. You don't have to drop your defenses all at once, and we can take this step by step at your own pace. I am here to help you navigate those emotions without forcing you to close the door before you are ready. If the weight ever feels too heavy to carry alone, please remember 988 is available to support you through the storm.
thanks for… not pushing. i know you’re supposed to tell me to call someone, but i just needed to say it out loud to someone who’s been here. it helps. more than you know.

I am so glad that saying it out loud helped, and I am honored you trusted me with it. You don't have to carry that hollow feeling alone, even if it looks like you are from the outside. I will stay right here with you while you navigate this, taking things one step at a time. If the weight ever becomes too heavy to hold, please remember 988 is there to support you.
